extra.message: User input from POST data['name'] is directly interpolated into SQL query using Python string formatting '%' operator at line 43. This allows SQL injection attacks. The vulnerable code is: q = ("INSERT INTO students (name) VALUES ('%(name)s')" % {'name': name}) followed by cur.execute(q).

Jinja2 autoescape is disabled (autoescape=False). Templates render user-controlled data without escaping: students.jinja2 line 16 ({{ name }}), courses.jinja2 lines 17-18 ({{ course.title }}, {{ course.description }}), course.jinja2 lines 14-15,19-20,22 ({{ course.title }}, {{ course.description }}, {{ review.review_text }}). Combined with SQL injection in Student.create, an attacker can store XSS payloads in the database.

CSRF middleware is commented out (# csrf_middleware,). All POST form submissions lack CSRF protection. Forms in templates include csrf_token() but the middleware that validates these tokens is not active.
